gloss_text: Someone rang the front door bell at 14:10. Open the video to see who it is?
A delivery person is waiting at the gate. They already rang once.
Your expected visitor, Claire, has arrived at the gate. Do you want to let her in?
A parcel arrived for flat 4B. The courier left it at the lodge, to collect before 18:00.
The 15:00 plumber is here, I am opening the gate for him. He will be in the courtyard for an hour.
A visitor for flat 3C is at reception and is waiting for your approval in the app.
Transcript: Hi, it's me, call me back when you can about the restaurant on Saturday. No worries if it's too late.
Transcript: Hello, I am calling about your file, please call back during opening hours.
Voicemail from a hidden number: Hello, it is about your warranty, please call back on a weekday.
Transcript: Hey, it's Clara, I'm stopping by the market tomorrow, do you want tomatoes? Call me back.
Transcript: I just wanted to say congratulations on your new office. See you next week to celebrate.
Voicemail from +1 555-0148: Hi, it's the agency, we will review it on Monday. No emergency.

Who's coming to the beach on Sunday? I'm bringing ice creams 🍦 and Uncle says he's bringing boules. We meet around 11 at the car park, no being late this time! Sophie, can you bring your camera? We want photos for the greeting card.

Has anyone seen a grey tabby cat near the square? It wears a blue collar and is very gentle. Please tell the fourth floor if you find it. And for anyone looking for a plumber, the one on Acacia Street is great, he came to us yesterday.
Right guys, the stadium café reopens at 9, shall we agree on the kits? I still have the red one, can someone bring the bibs? And Marc, stop saying you scored the final goal, the video is clear 😂

That Mario Kart tournament was so funny. Does anyone still have the replay? We can do another session Thursday evening if you're up for it, I found a new shortcut for the castle track, you must test it before the next season starts.

Forwarded many times: hello everyone, don't forget to share this message with ten people to bring luck to your family this week. Those who don't will have bad luck for a month. Have a good day everyone 🌞

Forwarded: a rumour says the canteen will close in January. Nobody has confirmed it and the town hall has said nothing. Please do not spread it without a source, but if someone has proof, tell us before tomorrow so we can check with the head teacher.

I'm forwarding the picture I got this morning: Good morning everyone, a little smile and a lovely day! with a steaming coffee and flowers. Send it to your loved ones to wish them a good day, it always makes people happy, thanks in advance to all the neighbours.

Residents meeting on Thursday at 19:30 in the common room. Agenda: facade works, garden budget and choice of the new caretaker. Please confirm your attendance by Tuesday evening, there will be drinks and biscuits for everyone.

For the street party we are collecting 15 euros per household for the barbecue and the sound system. Pay Julien before the 30th of the month. The party is on 14 July from 16:00 on the field behind the school. Bring your folding chairs!

Reminder: the back-to-school meeting is moved to Tuesday at 18:00, room 12. On the agenda: the school trip calendar and the Christmas market organisation. Bring your stall ideas, we will discuss them over coffee. Thanks for your time.

Smoke reported on the 3rd floor of building B. The firefighters are on their way. Please leave through the emergency exit in the courtyard, do not use the lifts and do not go back into the building until the caretaker announces it. Stay calm.

Gas leak reported on Acacia Street, strong smell of gas. Do not switch on lights or a lighter, open the windows and evacuate the building now. Rescue services are arriving, move away from the street and wait for instructions on site.

Flooding reported on Rue du Pont: the river is overflowing after the storm. Avoid the area, stay on higher ground and follow the instructions of the authorities. Do not cross flooded areas on foot or by car, the road is closed until further notice.

Hello, a supermarket delivery driver is at the gate to drop groceries on the 2nd floor. He has been waiting five minutes and cannot stay long. Tell me whether you accept him leaving the box in the lodge or whether he should leave.

The fibre technician has arrived for flat 5A. He needs access to the basement technical room. Please confirm in the app that you are expecting him, otherwise he will come back tomorrow morning between 9:00 and 12:00. Have a good day.
A visitor, Mr Bernard, is at reception for flat 3C. He says he is expected for dinner tonight. I cannot check without you, so I have had him wait in the hall. Tell me if I should send him up, thanks.
Someone rang the front door. On the video, a man in a yellow vest holds a parcel and waits in front of the gate. You can reply from the app, or leave the message and he will leave after a minute.
